info.title: LightRemote API
info.description: Browser-facing API for SSH, Telnet, VNC, SFTP, FTP, and FTPS connections. With LOCAL_MODE=true, the server uses one local owner and does not register setup, login, logout, password, or user-management endpoints.

get.summary: Check whether first-run administrator setup is required
get.description: Account mode only. Disabled once any non-local account exists.

post.summary: Install the first administrator and sign in
post.description: Account mode only. Requires a matching browser Origin and application/json. Installation cannot be repeated after an account exists.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: The configured PUBLIC_ORIGIN or the request Host with an HTTP(S) scheme

200.description: Session token, expiry, account, and CSRF token
Session token, expiry, account, and CSRF token

get.summary: Read the current account and CSRF token

patch.summary: Change an account's email, role, disabled state, or password (admin only)

put.description: Omit secret to retain saved credentials when kind and authType stay the same. Omit proxy or set it to null for a direct connection. Omit proxy.password to retain it only when type, host, port, and username are unchanged. Switching to Telnet requires no remote secret and clears saved remote credentials and host trust.

delete.summary: Delete a connection and close its work sessions

post.summary: Duplicate an owned connection, including its encrypted credentials
post.description: The backend decrypts and re-encrypts saved remote and proxy secrets for a new connection ID. The copy keeps its folder, remote settings, and approved SSH host key. Secrets are never returned in the response.

patch.summary: Move a connection into a folder or the root without closing its work sessions
Rename a connection without closing its work sessions

post.summary: Inspect an SSH or SFTP host key without trusting it
Approve the currently observed SSH or SFTP fingerprint
post.description: The server inspects the host key again and rejects approval if its SHA-256 fingerprint differs from the one submitted by the browser.

post.summary: Reserve an SSH, Telnet or VNC work session
post.description: A user may reserve up to 32 SSH, Telnet or VNC work sessions.

get.summary: Read a work session and traffic counters
Upgrade to an SSH, Telnet or VNC WebSocket
get.description: The browser Origin must match PUBLIC_ORIGIN, or the request host when unset. A new attachment replaces the previous browser viewer while preserving the remote session. Unattached sessions expire after two minutes. Browser clients authenticate by offering lightremote and lightremote.auth.<token> in Sec-WebSocket-Protocol; the server selects only lightremote. Bearer Authorization is also accepted.

vnc.serverClose: 1011 with a UTF-8 reason when upstream connection setup fails

telnet.serverBinary: Terminal output with Telnet negotiation commands removed

delete.summary: Delete a remote file or empty directory

200.description: Initial directory reported by SFTP or FTP; virtual drive root for VNC

parameters.name: X-Upload-Size
parameters.description: Original file size in bytes. Empty or mismatched upload bodies are rejected with upload_size_mismatch.

post.summary: Rename or move a remote entry

post.description: Keeps encrypted credentials in process memory. The returned connection has direct=true and is not listed or saved in a folder. Orphaned entries expire after 24 hours without access.

delete.summary: Delete an owned temporary connection and close its work sessions

websocketAuth.name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
websocketAuth.description: Offer lightremote and lightremote.auth.<token>; only accepted for viewer WebSocket upgrades.

RemotePath.name: path
RemotePath.description: Use / for a VNC drive list and C:/... for a Windows drive.

parentId.description: A folder may be nested up to 16 levels, counting top-level folders as level 1.

password.description: Required when username is set for a new proxy identity.

ftpTls.description: Required for FTP. True enables explicit FTPS; false explicitly chooses plain FTP.

vncEncoding.description: VNC framebuffer encoding preference. Unsupported choices fall back to Raw.

vncFileTransfer.description: Allow VNC file operations. False requires vncReadOnly to be true.

ConnectionInput.description: Telnet uses authType none and an empty or omitted username. Omit remote secret and sshKeyId; login is entered manually in the terminal.

direct.description: True for a temporary direct connection.

ftpTls.description: Required for FTP. True enables explicit FTPS; false explicitly chooses plain FTP.

vncEncoding.description: VNC framebuffer encoding preference. Unsupported choices fall back to Raw.

vncReadOnly.description: Disable VNC keyboard and clipboard input.

vncFileTransfer.description: Allow VNC file operations. False requires vncReadOnly to be true.

DirectConnectionInput.description: Telnet uses authType none and an empty or omitted username. Omit remote secret and sshKeyId; login is entered manually in the terminal.
